pandoc 
  to: html
  output-file: index.html
  standalone: true
  title-prefix: PI Name
  section-divs: true
  html-math-method: mathjax
  wrap: none
  default-image-extension: png
  css:
    - styles.css
  toc: false
  variables: {}
  
metadata
  document-css: false
  link-citations: true
  date-format: long
  lang: en
  theme: cosmo
  title: Brad Ross
  about:
    template: solana
    image: assets/headshot.jpg
    links:
      - icon: twitter
        text: Twitter
        href: https://twitter.com/username
      - icon: github
        text: Github
        href: https://github.com/username
      - icon: google-scholar
        text: Google Scholar
        href: https://scholar.google.com/
      - icon: envelope
        text: Email
        href: mailto:pi-email@university.edu
